issues.problem: Recommendation implies the address and hours are not published. They are already in the site header on every page checked ("Mon-Fri 9am-5pm", 82 Brunswick Woods Dr, East Brunswick NJ 08816), though the preloader hides them from visitors. Wording only; not a factual error about the business.
issues.fix: Rephrase to "keeps the existing address and hours visible on every page and inside the booking path".

issues.claim: Impact 1: "...1-2 converting at your published $99/month = about $1,180-$2,370 a year"
issues.problem: Arithmetic is 1 x $99 x 12 = $1,188 and 2 x $99 x 12 = $2,376; the printed figures are rounded down by about $8 and $6. Conservative, so not inflating, but the numbers shown do not reproduce exactly.
issues.fix: Use $1,190-$2,380, or state "about $1,190-$2,380 (1-2 clients x $99/month x 12, rounded)".

issues.claim: Loader "stuck at 9-32%" on each page opened
issues.problem: Reproduced, but the exact percentages differ by page and moment: blog 8%, contacts 14%, homepage 9% rising to about 61% over roughly three minutes and then stalling. The counter advances rather than freezing at a fixed value, so "9-32%" reads as a fixed range for all pages.
issues.fix: Say "never finished loading: the percentage counter was still climbing (8-32% across pages) after several minutes".
